name: directorio-freelancers
description: Production freelancer directory for a small production company or agency, on Google Drive: one card per freelancer (specialties, assignment limits, certifications with expiry, dated reliability facts, channel and language), availability requests drafted per person in priority order with the answers logged, and a weekly sweep of certifications about to expire. It never writes to the freelancers, books or pays anyone, or rates a person on its own.
